verification.notes: Transcript context at 1593-1650s is Aubrey Laitsch's detailed first-person description of her termination meeting. Her original public video and independent reporting consistently record that leadership presented the Uber driver's secondhand story as one reason for firing her; TPUSA has not publicly supplied records rebutting that account.
